verdict.rationale: Open mail protocols and standards-based export are a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no Superhuman IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access and no standards-based export (e.g. mbox/EML). The only related evidence is that Superhuman runs on top of Gmail and Outlook accounts (a host-platform property) and offers an MCP server for AI assistants, which is an adjacent feature and not open mail-protocol access or export.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
